{1: 'Port Podesta', 2: 'Present'}
{2: 'Port Podesta\\nPresent'}
{3: 'The streets have lost all familiarity. Illusions piece the city back together like a mosaic made of memory shards.'}
{3: "Under the Sefirah's influence, Port Podesta has been dragged into a collage of nostalgic fragments."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineSpreadNew.prefab', 2: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineSpreadNew.prefab'}
{1: '1007', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront172.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory428.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: '1007', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront172.png', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '1'}
{1: '1005', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory428.jpg', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '1'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{3: 'Leia tries to charge into the illusory bubbles, but a pulse of blue energy throws her back.'}
{2: 'Leia', 3: "Tch! No use, I can't get through!", 4: '1'}
{2: "They can't see us at all.", 3: '29'}
{3: 'You have tried multiple times now. No matter what you do, the civilians lost in the illusions remain beyond reach.'}
{3: 'Ophelia carries Helentine carefully down the steps and rests her against a wall that still seems steady.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Ophelia', 3: 'The Understanding Sefirah has dragged all of Port Podesta into an illusory world.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Ophelia', 3: 'Every person here is lost in a dream of their own, reunited with whoever they most long to see.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Ophelia', 3: 'What sustains it all is the Understanding Sefirah\'s manipulation of the Punishing Virus, combined with people\'s memories and their impressions of the "past."', 4: '1'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Ophelia', 3: "You're not from here. The Understanding Sefirah can't find a place for you in Port Podesta's reconstruction. Right now, we're caught in the gap between reality and the domain of Understanding.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Ophelia', 3: 'Any outside interference gets filtered as noise inside that space. A faint ripple is the most we can manage.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Ophelia', 3: "These bubbles are held together by people's own memories and emotions. Anything that doesn't belong just registers as static in the dream.", 4: '1'}
{2: '...Then how are you able to move around in here?', 3: '47'}
{2: 'Ophelia', 3: "I suppose you've seen my sister's memories already...", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Ophelia', 3: "I'm not like the dead the Punishing Virus conjures. Years ago, to save my sister, my father and I severed part of my consciousness and used it to fill the gaps in her M.I.N.D.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Ophelia', 3: 'The missing part of me was replaced by the "Understanding" Sefirah\'s proxy calculation unit. But eventually, the Sefirah and I began rejecting each other. To keep Port Podesta from catastrophe, I ended my own life.', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Ophelia', 3: 'A fragment of my data remained preserved inside the "Understanding" Sefirah. But for reasons I still can\'t explain... that fragment escaped the Tidal Hub and became "Ophelia".', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: "Wait, wait, wait... I'm lost. Are you saying you're literally part of the Sefirah?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'But if the illusions are made of the Punishing Virus...', 3: '60'}
{2: 'Ophelia', 3: "Then what am I made of? Is that what you're asking?", 4: '1'}
{3: "Ophelia bows her head and gently sweeps a stray strand of hair from Helentine's temple."}

{1: '1', 2: 'Ophelia', 3: 'When I first opened my eyes, I was lying in some alley in the rain. I was terrified. Everything around me felt completely foreign. I ran, and on instinct, I called my sister.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'So it really was you who reached out to Helentine.', 3: '68'}
{2: 'Ophelia', 3: 'Yes. As for the rest, I don\'t know any more than you do. But from what this body remembers of the Sefirah and the Tidal Hub... it all seems to lead back to an "agent."', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Ophelia', 3: 'That agent painted a beautiful enough future for my father. But I could tell there were others, too, scheming something in Port Podesta, just out of sight...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Do you remember what the agent looked like?', 3: '72'}
{2: 'Ophelia', 3: "Short, purple hair, in a wheelchair. And it wasn't his real body.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: 'Wait, I thought Lithos was always an Ascendant...?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'It might tie back to Vonnegut.', 3: '78'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Ophelia', 3: "The Veil Rain project can sustain this city's dream. But to keep it going, or expand it, they need more data. And that means more people swallowed by the Punishing Virus.", 4: '1'}
{3: "She raises her head and takes in the city that's shaking violently through the roar."}
{2: "So that's why Tavis is driving Port Podesta toward land...", 3: '83'}
{2: 'Ophelia', 3: "This mechanical whale was abandoned years ago. It ran out of fuel. If it's moving now, it can only be the Sefirah's doing.", 4: '1'}
{2: "Then, to stop Tavis and Lithos' scheme, we need to seize or destroy the Sefirah.", 3: '86'}
{2: "But Helentine's wounded, and the Tidal Hub where the Sefirah is stored is swarming with Red Tide Projections.", 3: '87'}
{2: "Most of the people in Port Podesta who could help are trapped in the Sefirah's illusions, their lives at risk.", 3: '88'}
{2: 'And if we charge into the Tidal Hub unprepared... we walk straight into Lithos and Tavis.', 3: '89'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: 'What about affecting the Sefirah from the outside? Is that even possible?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Ophelia', 3: "...My father's method relies on the collective consciousness of the people. He uses it to recreate the past, then manifests it through the Punishing Virus.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Ophelia', 3: "Which means people's consciousness is part of what shapes the Understanding Sefirah's output.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'So what we need... is to make them see the reality of their situation.', 3: '97'}
{2: 'We need to change their minds.', 3: '98'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: 'But there are so many of these bubbles... how are we supposed to reach them all one by one?', 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1567.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1567.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiguzhangNew.prefab'}

{3: 'Your gaze moves past the streets and into the layered illusions pressing in on one another. Buildings from different decades, streets that belong to separate years, all bleeding together through folded light and misplaced silhouettes.'}
{3: 'And in the middle of all this chaos, you notice something that is not changing.'}
{3: 'A tower. No matter how the eras shift around it, it stays exactly where it has always been.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1567.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Ophelia', 3: "Remember? We're in the gap between the Understanding Sefirah's domain and reality.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Ophelia', 3: 'Port Podesta itself might have something that can reach everyone... Look.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'A signal tower...?', 3: '128'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Ophelia', 3: "From the Golden Age. It's been abandoned for years, but because of everything that has happened to the city, it's still functional.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Ophelia', 3: "Back then, there was no divide between the port and the city. The tower's signal connected everyone.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Ophelia', 3: "That tower exists in every Port Podesta resident's dream, because it once belonged to all of them.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'So we take the signal tower and broadcast the truth to the people.', 3: '133'}
{2: "Weaken the Sefirah's hold and wake them up.", 3: '134'}
{3: 'Ophelia answers with a slight nod.'}
{2: "That's our primary plan.", 3: '138'}
{2: 'But if it fails, Leia...', 3: '139'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: 'I get it. We storm the Tidal Hub, right?', 4: '1'}
{3: 'You give her a nod.'}
{2: "...I'm leaving Helentine in your hands, Ophelia.", 3: '144'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Ophelia', 3: "I'll stay with her.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Ophelia', 3: "When she wakes up, I'll explain everything and catch up with you as soon as I can.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Ophelia', 3: "The signal tower isn't far, but the layout of Port Podesta has shifted.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Ophelia', 3: 'Let them guide you in my place.', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiChatServeMain/FxUiChatServe01.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: '1', 3: "She claps her hands, and a few round, odd-looking creatures come hopping out from the city's dark corners.", 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Ophelia', 3: "These are Port Podesta's Huhus. Follow them, and they'll get you to the tower.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Ophelia leans down and murmurs something to the Huhus.'}
{1: 'PanelActor2Shake'}
{3: 'The octopus-like creatures gesture in reply, but their tentacles are so stubby that the motions look utterly comical.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: 'Whoa! What the heck are these little guys?!', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Ophelia', 3: 'They used to be the most popular artificial pets in the TEC. The streets are a mess right now; they know them better than you do.', 4: '1'}
{2: "Let's move, Leia.", 3: '185'}

{1: '1', 3: "Tavis' eyes are fixed on the surveillance display."}
{3: 'A short pause. Then he changes the view, tracking the silhouettes moving toward the signal tower.'}
{2: 'Tavis', 3: "It's not time yet to wake up from the dream...", 4: '1'}

{3: 'He taps the panel. The command goes out, and the streets surrounding the signal tower stir like something startled from hibernation.'}
{1: 'PanelActor15Shake'}
{3: "Red light flares in the projections' eyes. Mechanoids that should lie dead begin to spasm, limbs twisting and convulsing against the ground."}
{3: 'They do not wear the gentle faces of the revived.'}

{3: 'The wall buckles inward, leaving a cratered dent. But more Corrupted are already crawling from the dust and smoke.'}
{3: 'Their claws scratch against the ground, their movements still clumsy and slow.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStorySandNew.prefab'}
{1: '1', 3: "The Huhu in your arms points toward the roadside. It's a motorcycle.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: 'Why are there so many Corrupted here?!', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Leia vaults onto the roadside motorcycle in one swift motion. She tests the ignition, and to her surprise, the engine catches.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: 'Commandant, Huhu, hop on!', 4: '1'}
{2: '(Get on the seat)', 3: '295'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineFocusNew.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake2Loop'}
{3: 'The projections and mechanoids massing around you grow more numerous by the second.'}
{2: 'Leia, straight through! Into the signal tower!', 3: '307'}

{3: 'The motorcycle plows through half the roller shutter. The front end buckles on impact, and the brutal recoil almost lifts the entire bike off the ground.'}
{3: 'Your body goes light for a split second before gravity hammers you back into the seat.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The Huhu clings to the rear of the bike in terror, its round body squashing flat in the wind.', 4: '1'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiMohuTest03.prefab'}
{3: 'Your vision blacks out briefly. The crash leaves only a sharp ringing in your ears.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'You tuck the Huhu beneath you, shielding it with your body.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The Huhu springs from your arms, its stubby tentacles jabbing upward.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'The citywide comms control room is upstairs?', 3: '353'}
{3: 'The Huhu nods and scuttles over to the dead elevator, bouncing up to hit the button for the eighth floor.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Behind you, Corrupted are already massing beyond the shattered roller door.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Leia', 3: '【kuroname】, you go to the control room.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Leia', 3: "Someone's gotta keep these things busy down here. If they crash your broadcast halfway through, this whole plan's shot.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'You sure you can handle this alone?', 3: '368'}
{2: 'Leia', 3: "Don't worry about me. I can hold the line for a while.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Leia', 3: 'Then get moving, 【kuroname】!', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1029.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineFocusNew.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake2Loop'}
{3: 'Without hesitation, you turn and bolt for the stairs.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineFocusNew.prefab'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The Huhu bounces ahead, and the overhead lights flicker on one by one, revealing the crumbling steps in the dark stairwell.', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiMovie/FxUiMovieLuochen.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: 'The stairwell shakes violently as the terrain shifts. Dust pours from above. You steady yourself against the wall and push higher.'}

{1: 'Port Podesta City Communications Control Room', 2: 'Eighth Floor'}
{2: 'Eighth Floor, Port Podesta City Communications Control Room'}
{3: 'Inside, dozens of screens glow at once. Ancient dust drifts through the air, floating above the false illusions playing across the monitors.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1534.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{3: 'On the surveillance feeds, you can see even Leia fighting the Corrupted. Another screen shows Wynne, still lost in her illusion back at the office.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1534.jpg', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '1'}
{3: 'You draw a deep breath. All or nothing now. You reach for the broadcast microphone on the main console.'}
{2: '(Press the red broadcast button)', 3: '408'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0', 4: '0.8', 5: '0.3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiLivWarmActivity/FxUiLivWarmActivityVinylBo01.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: 'No time to hesitate or prepare. You must rely on instinct and experience alone for what you are about to say.'}
{2: 'Citizens of Port Podesta, this is the Gray Raven Commandant from Babylonia.', 3: '415'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1564.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1'}
{3: 'Your voice floats across Port Podesta, echoing through every distinct illusion across the city.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory182.png'}

{1: 'Port Podesta Docks', 2: 'Before the Atlantic Calamity'}
{2: 'Before the Atlantic Calamity\\nPort Podesta Docks'}
{3: 'The port hums with industry. Rollers turn in the cargo bays. Workers fit metal plates into ship hulls, each piece locking home in seamless rhythm.'}

{3: 'Around them, the docks are a symphony of welding sparks, swinging booms, and hoarse shouts. On the horizon, the Atlantic Eye spreads its outer shell across the water like a giant iron shell catching the light.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Crassus balances on the repair scaffold, chewing an energy bar, a checklist creased in his grip.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Worker', 3: 'Crassus! Port thruster readings are off!', 4: '18'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: "I know! It's been sitting since yesterday! Let me finish the electrical diagnostics first, then I'll get to it!", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: "Put your side on hold and go help the other crew! They're falling behind!", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: "I've got this ship covered on my own.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Worker', 3: 'Got it. Good luck, man.', 4: '18'}
{3: 'Crassus stoops down, digging a multimeter from his kit, and reaches toward the exposed wiring.'}
{3: 'From the side, a hand extends toward him, a bottle held out in quiet offering.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'He glances back. A young woman is half-kneeling on the other end of the rig.'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'Thanks for your work, Crassus.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Crassus', 3: "Helentine? What brings you here? Weren't you handling the supply contracts yesterday?", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Helentine', 3: 'Already sorted. I sat through a whole afternoon of meetings, got the contract signed, and came straight back.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'I asked around, and they said you were shorthanded over here. But it looks like... you were planning to just power through it alone again.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'I brought drinks for everyone. Here.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Crassus unscrews the cap and tips the bottle back, swallowing hard. His breath leaves him in a slow, heavy sigh.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Crassus', 3: "Thanks... I've gotta get this ship wrapped up today, and there's still a mountain of work left.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Helentine', 3: "Then I'd say I came to the right place. What do you need me to do?", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Crassus', 3: 'When you put it like that, I almost feel bad asking.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Crassus bites off the last piece of his energy bar.'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: 'If you really want to help, check the electrical conduits over there.', 4: '1'}
{3: "A crane inches overhead, dragging the huge shadow of the ship's hull across them both."}
{3: 'The sea breeze stirs together the smells of engine oil, saltwater, and scorched metal from the welding torches. It is the scent of that era, the one he remembers.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Helentine', 3: 'When does this ship launch?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Crassus', 3: "A few more days. Once I wrap up maintenance and she passes one more round of testing, we hand her over. Client's been pushing hard.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Helentine', 3: "No wonder you've been so buried. You're racing a deadline.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Crassus', 3: "Almost there. Just gotta push through a little longer. Not like there's anyone else to do it.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'He flips the checklist in his hand to the next page.'}
{3: 'A sudden broadcast blares over the speakers, cutting their conversation short. The audio quality is abysmal, and only fragments of the message are intelligible.'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong02.prefab'}
{3: 'A faint dissonance tugs at him.'}
{3: 'He remembers that Constellia in this era should still be...'}
{3: 'This era?'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong03.prefab'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Crassus', 3: "Your old man's doing again? If he's gonna set something up, he could at least make it work right.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Crassus', 3: "Hey, let's talk about something good. I'm taking three days off starting tomorrow.", 4: '1'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Crassus', 3: "Project's on a tight schedule. Honestly, I'm lucky I even got three approved.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Crassus', 3: "Besides, I'm practically part of the furniture around here at this point. Can't just walk away when things get busy, right?", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Crassus', 3: "The new kids still can't figure out half the repairs. So I cover what they can't handle. Long road ahead of them. Might as well help where I can.", 4: '1'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Crassus', 3: "Can't win an argument with her, so... sigh. I work on ships all day, and now I'm spending my vacation around more ships.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Helentine', 3: 'You really do spoil her.', 4: '1'}
{3: "Helentine's hands never stop. She works through the instrument panel, the pressure valves, checking each item in sequence. Her section of the pipeline is already done."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Crassus', 3: 'How are you this fast?!', 4: '1'}

{1: '1', 3: 'Wynne sits at her desk, the computer screen glowing. A half-written article waits on the last period, cursor blinking.'}

{2: 'Chief Editor', 3: 'Sit.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Chief Editor', 3: 'That piece you wrote yesterday turned out pretty well.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Chief Editor', 3: '"Port Podesta\'s Golden Age Dream." We ran three printings yesterday alone. Solid numbers.', 4: '1'}

{3: 'As the chief editor lists these things, an odd feeling of unfamiliarity creeps over her.'}
{3: 'From what she remembers, he never used to talk this way.'}
{2: 'Chief Editor', 3: 'Point is... your stuff has been consistently good lately.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Chief Editor', 3: "I've been thinking. How about putting you in charge of our next headline? What do you say?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Chief Editor', 3: "Or maybe you'd rather cover the signal tower? The radio station needs content too.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'A sudden swell of emotion tightens her throat at the praise. Compliments from the chief editor are a rare thing.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Wynne', 3: 'Chief... I thought you...', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Chief Editor', 3: "What? Don't look at me like that. I push you hard most days, and now I say something honest and you go all emotional.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Chief Editor', 3: "That whole thing you did for Professor Liston, whipping up public support like that. It was chaos. Anyone else would've packed it in, but you pushed that story through anyway.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Chief Editor', 3: "At least you've still got some fight in you about what real journalism should be.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Chief Editor', 3: "Truth is, I've always respected that. Otherwise I would've killed every one of those pieces a long time ago.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Chief Editor', 3: 'Look. Reality\'s too harsh for most people. But you slap "Golden Age" on the cover, and they\'ll line up to buy it.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Chief Editor', 3: "The truth doesn't really matter. Look at the sales numbers.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Chief Editor', 3: "Ah, forget it. Let's not get into all that. Come on, time to celebrate your success.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The editor pulls a bottle and two small glasses from his drawer with practiced ease, as if he has done this many times before.'}
{3: 'She accepts the glass, a little overwhelmed. In the hazy light, the front page of the newspaper on the desk gleams almost painfully bright.'}
{3: '"Golden Age Dream"?'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Wynne', 3: 'Hey... Chief? What year is it again?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Chief Editor', 3: "Ahh, why bring that up now? We're having a good time.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Right, this is a happy occasion. No need to get hung up on the details.'}
{3: 'The news, when you think about it, is just a dream factory.'}

{2: 'Citizens of Port Podesta. My name is 【kuroname】, Gray Raven Commandant of Babylonia.', 3: '927'}
{1: '1006', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png', 3: '0', 4: '0.8', 5: '0.3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiLivWarmActivity/FxUiLivWarmActivityVinylBo01.prefab', 2: '2'}
{2: '【kuroname】', 3: "But right now, that doesn't matter. I know what you're facing."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1559.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1559.jpg'}
{2: '【kuroname】', 3: "A person. Maybe a dinner table. Maybe a street you haven't walked in years."}
{2: '【kuroname】', 3: "Whatever it is, I understand. It's what you want to see most right now."}
{2: '【kuroname】', 3: "I'm not going to lie and tell you those things aren't real."}
{2: '【kuroname】', 3: "They're real to you."}
{2: '【kuroname】', 3: "And I have no right to tell you those visions shouldn't exist."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory352.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory352.jpg'}
{2: '【kuroname】', 3: "But there's something I have to say."}
{2: '【kuroname】', 3: 'Right now, Port Podesta is drowning in illusions born from the Punishing Virus.'}
{2: '【kuroname】', 3: "The world you're experiencing can only keep going by consuming human lives."}
{2: '【kuroname】', 3: "If this continues, you'll become part of it too."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory182.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/Bgstory182.png'}
{2: '【kuroname】', 3: 'Port Podesta, this city built on a mechanical creature... is heading toward land.'}
{2: '【kuroname】', 3: 'Toward Constellia.'}
{2: '【kuroname】', 3: 'When it reaches shore, the corruption will spread outward from there.'}
{2: '【kuroname】', 3: 'The people on land are no different from you.'}
{2: '【kuroname】', 3: "They have people they want to see. Words they never got to say. But they don't know they're about to become fuel for the Punishing Virus."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1532.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1532.jpg'}
{2: '【kuroname】', 3: "Please. Look outside. Look at Port Podesta. Look at what's happening right now."}
{2: '【kuroname】', 3: 'Tavis lied to you. What you are seeing now is not reality.'}
{2: '【kuroname】', 3: "Reality is cruel. It stings. It's barren..."}
{2: '【kuroname】', 3: "But it's exactly because of that harshness that I believe reality can push us toward something better. Something good."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1564.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '1.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1564.jpg'}
{2: '【kuroname】', 3: 'The future only moves forward when we let go of the past.'}
{2: '【kuroname】', 3: 'And it moves forward through your actions. Right here. Right now.'}
{2: '【kuroname】', 3: "This shouldn't be where your lives end. And it shouldn't be the end of Port Podesta—"}
